Playing Mario Party online (alpha)
==================================

Two to four players, each on their own computer with this same release, the same Mario Party (USA) ROM, the same
mods enabled and the same Board Movement and Map Scrolling settings. One player hosts; the others join.

1. The host: run host.bat (Windows) or host.sh (Linux, from a terminal). Say how many players, you included.
2. Each other player: run join.bat or join.sh. Give the host's address, the number of players, and your own player
   number (2, 3 or 4: each player a different one).
3. The game's launcher opens as usual: pick your ROM with Load ROM the first time, then start the game. The screen
   stays black until every player has started and every copy matches (up to five minutes), then the game begins.
   Each player plays with their own first controller (or the keyboard).

The host's address
------------------
The others must be able to reach UDP port 7845 on the host's computer:

- Over the internet: forward UDP port 7845 on the host's router to the host's computer, and give the others the
  host's public address (a site such as whatismyip.com shows it).
- Easier: everyone joins the same Tailscale or ZeroTier network, and the host gives its address there.
- On the same home network: the host's local address (like 192.168.1.20).

Allow the program through the firewall if your computer asks.

What to expect
--------------
- Everyone plays from the host's save. Your own save isn't changed: a guest's session saves to saves/netplay instead.
- Every player's buttons arrive three frames (0.1 s) after they are pressed, so everyone sees the same game. If the
  game stutters, players are far apart: try a delay of 5 or 6, the same number for every player.
- If something goes wrong (a player leaves, the copies differ, or the games ever play differently), each copy shows
  a message saying what happened and closes. A message about the game playing differently ("desynced") is a bug we
  want to hear about: note the frame it names.

This is an alpha: there is no menu for online play yet, and no way to rejoin a session that ended.
